recognize_zh: 四顆大型細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，把核的輪廓都遮住了；右側一顆核呈雙葉、中間凹陷（bilobed / butterfly nucleus），部分細胞有淡藍色細胞質伸出，這是典型顆粒過多型前骨髓細胞（hypergranular promyelocyte）。
features: Large cells, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules that obscure nuclear detail
Nuclear outline visible as bilobed/folded (butterfly-like) in at least one cell
Some cells show a pale, agranular basophilic cytoplasmic bleb or tail
No distinct Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) are resolved in this field
Background of red cells with drying artifact; no mature neutrophils in field
describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal cells amid red cells. The cells have abundant cytoplasm so densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that the nuclear outline is largely obscured; where visible, nuclei are folded to bilobed. A few cells have a pale agranular cytoplasmic protrusion. Auer rod bundles are not clearly resolved in this field. Findings are consistent with abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA is indicated.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocytes (e.g., G-CSF effect, marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a visible Golgi hof and granules that do not obscure the nucleus, and they occur with orderly maturation rather than as a dominant population.
Blasts in t(8;21) show fewer granules, a single long Auer rod, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules, without the bilobed, granule-obscured nuclei of APL.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules, whereas these cells are overtly packed with coarse granules; both require PML::RARA confirmation.

Monoblasts/promonocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and delicate folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, and are MPO weak with nonspecific esterase positivity, unlike strongly MPO-positive APL cells.
